title: Cruise Ship Crews Don't Get Days Off
asof: Figures as of 2026 · full video on the channel

shots.s: On a cruise ship, the crew works every single day.

d.small: for months · no real day off

shots.s: Most contracts have no real days off.
A few hours on, a break, then back on at night.
Galley crews can start before breakfast,
and finish after the late-night cleanup.
Yes. The Maritime Labour Convention sets one.

d.small: minimum rest in any 24 hours · MLC 2006

shots.s: At least ten hours of rest in any twenty-four.
At least seventy-seven hours in any week.
They often land in your rest time.
Could you work every day for six months?
